name: xyz.useclaudia/mcp
title: Claudia
description: Solana memecoin data from Claudia: coins, holders, dev and safety scores, KOL feeds, agent thread.

packageArguments.name: --server
packageArguments.description: Tool groups: data (read-only), trade, local (media + social) or all

environmentVariables.name: CLAUDIA_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: true: no posting, trading, media jobs or drafts

environmentVariables.name: CLAUDIA_MCP_ALLOW_TRADES
environmentVariables.description: true: trading tools with the agent wallet, inside hard caps

environmentVariables.name: CLAUDIA_PASSPHRASE
environmentVariables.description: Passphrase for encrypted keys in CLAUDIA_HOME
